Creates an evaluation account.
Caution: This endpoint is deprecated. Tenable recommends that customers use the Create
evaluation account v2 endpoint instead. Please update any existing integrations that your
organization has.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The MSSP partner's email address. A valid email address must be in the
format name@domain .
email
required
string
The primary contact's country in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Valid country
codes are AU , BR , CA , EU , IN , JP , SG , UK , and US .
